record.paper_title: The Flow Associated to Weakly Differentiable Vector Fields: Recent Results and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Differentiability in measure of the flow
record.original_question: Let X(t,x) be the L^d-regular Lagrangian flow associated to a nonsmooth vector field b. In the W^{1,1} case one knows that, for almost every t, there exists a measurable matrix-valued map W_t(x) such that the difference quotients (X(t,x+εy)-X(t,x))/ε converge locally in measure to W_t(x)y as ε↓0. Does this derivative-in-measure property remain valid for BV vector fields?

evidence.quote: Then for a.e. t ∈ (0, T) there exists a measurable function Wt : Rd → Md×d such that (X(t, x + εy) − X(t, x))/ε → Wt(x)y locally in measure in Rdx × Rdy as ε ↓ 0, uniformly in time.
(4.1) is the only differentiability property known in the W1,1 case, and unknown in the BV case.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $b:(0,T)\times\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}^d$ be a (possibly nonsmooth) vector field of bounded variation in the spatial variable, and let $X:[0,T]\times\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}^d$ denote an $\mathcal{L}^d$-regular Lagrangian flow associated to $b$; that is, $X(\cdot,x)$ solves $\dot\gamma(t)=b(t,\gamma(t))$, $\gamma(0)=x$, for a.e. $x$, and the pushforward $X(t,\cdot)_\#\mathcal{L}^d$ is bounded by a constant multiple of $\mathcal{L}^d$ uniformly in $t\in[0,T]$.

In the Sobolev case $b\in L^1((0,T);W^{1,1}_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb{R}^d;\mathbb{R}^d))$ it is known that for almost every $t\in(0,T)$ there exists a measurable map $W_t:\mathbb{R}^d\to M_{d\times d}(\mathbb{R})$ such that
$$\frac{X(t,x+\varepsilon y)-X(t,x)}{\varepsilon}\ \longrightarrow\ W_t(x)\,y\qquad (\varepsilon\downarrow 0)$$
locally in measure on $\mathbb{R}^d_x\times\mathbb{R}^d_y$, uniformly in $t$.

Question: Does this differentiability-in-measure property of the Lagrangian flow $X$ continue to hold when $b\in L^1((0,T);BV_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb{R}^d;\mathbb{R}^d))$ (with a suitable bound on the divergence ensuring the existence of an $\mathcal{L}^d$-regular Lagrangian flow)?
artifact.category_tag: Lagrangian flows of BV vector fields
artifact.status_search_result: Bianchini and Bonicatto established differentiability in measure of the Lagrangian flow for nearly incompressible BV vector fields (Arch. Ration. Mech. Anal., 2022), giving a positive answer in the nearly incompressible BV setting. Further partial progress exists in the 2-D autonomous case (Bonicatto–Marconi, 2021). The general BV case (e.g., merely with bounded divergence and no nearly-incompressibility assumption) does not appear to have been fully resolved in the literature located.

status_evidence.title: Differentiability in Measure of the Flow Associated with a Nearly Incompressible BV Vector Field
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the regularity of the flow associated with nearly incompressible BV vector fields, proving differentiability in measure in the sense of Ambrosio–Malý.
status_evidence.claim: The differentiability-in-measure property is established for nearly incompressible BV vector fields, giving a partial positive resolution.

status_evidence.title: Differentiability properties of the flow of 2d autonomous vector fields
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates under which assumptions the flow associated to autonomous planar vector fields inherits Sobolev or BV regularity.
status_evidence.claim: Additional partial results are known in the 2-D autonomous BV setting.
